Resolves #21649

Scheduler `eventChange` and Gantt `taskChange` now expose the edit origin as `changeSource`, preserving `source` as the sender's component id. Callers continue to supply `meta.source`. The two other overwritten literal `source` keys are removed from the dock projection and chip-removal events. Both guides and the affected JSDoc describe the payload contract.

Evidence: L2 (real listener assertions and an AST scan of engine event payloads) → L2 required (event metadata and regression coverage; no visual change).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/scheduler/Container.spec.mjs` checks actual `eventChange` listeners after ArrowRight moves, Shift+ArrowRight resizes and bare API calls. It also checks a caller-supplied origin. `source` remains the scheduler id. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/gantt/Container.spec.mjs` checks the corresponding `taskChange` listener contract for keyboard, API and drag edits, plus caller-supplied resize metadata, retaining the Gantt id in `source`. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/core/ObservablePayloadSource.spec.mjs` parses every engine `.mjs` file and rejects literal `fire` payloads declaring `source`. Its fixtures check shorthand, quoted and computed literal keys, without matching comments, strings or nested metadata. |
| AC-4 | Static inspection: `learn/guides/datahandling/Scheduler.md` and `learn/guides/datahandling/Gantt.md` name `changeSource` in their listener descriptions and distinguish it from the sender id. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. `Observable#fire`, input metadata and example code are unchanged. Payloads built outside an object literal remain outside the guard's scope, as specified in the ticket.

## Test Evidence

- Before/after regression proof against upstream dev `7cd0d6618e`: before the production repair, the listener assertions fail on missing `changeSource` and the guard reports the four named collisions. The same regression run passes after the repair. Local receipts: `before.log` and `after.log`.
- Regression coverage runs in the existing unit CI tier. No browser/E2E run or rendered-page evidence is claimed.
- The full unit tier also passed locally on the final tree in UTC with four workers; receipt: `full-unit.log`.
- Applicable `lint-staged` checks pass. Change class: restoration (`fix`); `agent-preflight` is not hosted in this checkout.

None required.
